account.title: Account
account.description: Your sign-in details and how other members see you.
account.identityDescription: The account you sign in with.
account.emailHint: Your email comes from your sign-in account and can't be changed here.
account.profileDescription: Members of your organizations see this name.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Language, time zone, currency and theme.

regional.title: Language and region
regional.description: Dates show in your time zone; new amounts use the currency you pick.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.description: Applied right away and saved to your profile.
theme.saveFailed: The theme is applied here but wasn't saved to your profile.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.description: Ask for a code besides your password every time you sign in.
mfa.emptyDescription: Add an authenticator app or a phone to protect your account.
mfa.unavailable: Two-step verification isn't available in this environment.
mfa.removeDescription: You won't be able to use it to sign in anymore.
mfa.removeLastDescription: It's your only factor: once removed, signing in asks for your password only.
mfa.totpDescription: Use an app such as Google Authenticator, 1Password or Authy.
mfa.totpStepScan: Scan the QR code with the authenticator app on your phone. If the app is on this device, open the link; without a camera, type the setup key.
mfa.totpQrLabel: QR code to set up the authenticator app
mfa.totpStepCode: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
mfa.setupKeyHint: Shown only while you set it up. Don't share it.
mfa.smsDescription: We'll text you a code every time you sign in.
mfa.phoneHint: International format, with + and the country code. E.g. +1 415 555 0132.
mfa.phoneInvalid: Enter the number in international format, starting with +.
mfa.smsCodeHint: The text arrives in a few seconds.
mfa.codeWrong: Wrong or expired code. Try again.
mfa.factorNameHint: Helps you recognize this factor later.

password.title: Password
password.description: For your security, confirm your current password first.

errors.sameAsCurrent: The new password must differ from the current one.
errors.weak: This password is too weak. Use more characters and mix letters, numbers and symbols.

password.mfaDescription: Enter the code from your second factor to change your password.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Where your account is signed in right now.
sessions.listDescription: Revoke the sessions you do not recognize. To end the one on this device, sign out.
sessions.caption: Sessions of your account
sessions.emptyDescription: Sessions show up here when you sign in on a browser or the app.

revoke.title: Revoke this session?
revoke.description: {name} will be signed out on its next activity.

revokeAll.title: Sign out everywhere
revokeAll.sectionDescription: Ends every session, this one included. Use it if you lost a device or suspect someone else signed in.
revokeAll.description: Every session will end, this one included, and you'll be taken to the sign-in page.
revokeAll.done: You're signed out on every device.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose what you want to receive.

productUpdates.label: Product updates
productUpdates.description: New features and improvements, at most once a week.
productUpdates.disabled: You won't receive product updates anymore.

securityAlerts.label: Security alerts
securityAlerts.description: Always on: they tell you about new sign-ins and account changes.
